lead.event: MSCI's proposed Indonesia reclassification draws reactions and market consequences
lead.headline: MSCI's proposed Indonesia reclassification triggers sell-off wiping US$65 billion
lead.blurb: The index provider is weighing a direct move from Emerging Market to Standalone Market status, citing concerns about investability, ownership transparency and regulatory enforcement. The two-day rout included an 11.6% IHSG drop on Friday, its deepest daily fall since 1998. During consultation, MSCI has frozen increases to Indonesia’s Foreign Inclusion Factor and Number of Shares and barred additions or upgrades to its investable-market index. Consultation ends 30 April 2027, with a decision due by 30 June and implementation possible from August 2027.
lead.copy_decision: rewritten: regrouped, 5 of its articles moved out

capital_raising_buybacks.event: PTPP finalizes Rp18.2 trillion debt restructuring
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: PTPP finalizes Rp18.2 trillion debt restructuring
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Pembangunan Perumahan’s agreement with Bank Mandiri, BRI, BNI and BSI covers principal and interest obligations as of July 2026. It took effect on 21 October, with about Rp13.33 trillion due over 15 years at 3.5% annual interest and about Rp4.05 trillion due within five years, funded by asset divestments.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: BRI plans a second-phase Rp1 trillion share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BBRI plans second-phase share buyback of up to Rp1 trillion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: BRI reported OJK approval for the program, which runs from 22 October to 21 January 2027 and will be funded from internal cash. Repurchased shares are expected to represent up to 0.20% of outstanding shares and are planned for employee and/or director and commissioner ownership programs, subject to shareholder approval.
capital_raising_buybacks.copy_decision: rewritten: 4 new articles with a new fact: The company reported OJK approval for the new buyback.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Amman Mineral plans a Rp1 trillion share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: AMMN plans a Rp1 trillion share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Amman Mineral expects to repurchase about 266.84 million shares, up to 0.37% of its capital, using internal cash, with BCA Sekuritas executing the buyback through 22 January 2027. Pro forma cash and equivalents would fall from US$676.8 million to US$621.4 million, and the shares will be held as treasury stock.
capital_raising_buybacks.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: Pro forma cash and equivalents would fall from US$676.8 million to US$621.4 million.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: VKTR begins realizing its rights issue
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: VKTR begins rights issue, issuing 609.81 million shares
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: The offer covers 15 billion shares at Rp 200 each, with 12.54 billion still unexercised as of 21 October. About 66.86% of net proceeds is planned for a capital injection into Sarana Ekomobilitas Indonesia to support purchases of VKTR electric vehicles in 2026-2027, and rights exercise closes on 23 October.

market_structure_policy.event: IDX excludes high-concentration and acceleration-board stocks from the JCI
market_structure_policy.headline: IDX excludes high-concentration and acceleration-board stocks, affecting around 18% of JCI
market_structure_policy.blurb: The change takes effect on 2 November and is not a delisting, IDX President Director Jeffrey Hendrik said. Regular reviews shift to January, April, July and October, with changes effective on the first trading day of February, May, August and November. The 9% cap remains unchanged.
market_structure_policy.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: The excluded stocks were estimated to account for around 18% of the index.

market_structure_policy.event: OJK imposes sanctions in DSSA, BREN, and CUAN capital-market violation cases
market_structure_policy.headline: OJK imposes Rp2.1 trillion in sanctions in DSSA, BREN and CUAN cases
market_structure_policy.blurb: OJK says criminal prosecution could follow if manipulation perpetrators fail to cooperate in resolving cases through administrative fines by the deadline. The sanctions include Rp1.5 trillion for SMT in Dian Swastatika Sentosa share trading, Rp500 billion for AH Ltd in Barito Renewables Energy’s IPO and Rp100 billion for TC Pte Ltd in Petrindo Jaya Kreasi’s IPO, with letters delivered on 21 October.
market_structure_policy.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: OJK said criminal prosecution could follow if manipulation perpetrators fail to cooperate by the deadline.

earnings_guidance.blurb: DCI Indonesia’s net profit reached Rp919.84 billion for January–September 2026, while colocation revenue rose 32.97% year on year to Rp2.38 trillion. Total assets rose 51.38% to Rp10.06 trillion as of 30 September 2026.

earnings_guidance.blurb: January-September sales reached Rp25.75 trillion. Net profit of Rp4.2 trillion included Sariwangi, divested in March, while profit excluding discontinued operations rose 10.6% to Rp3.3 trillion.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: 3 new articles with a new fact: Excluding discontinued operations, net profit rose 10.6% to Rp3.3 trillion.

earnings_guidance.event: Pradiksi Gunatama reports nine-month 2026 profit growth
earnings_guidance.headline: PGUN reports 33.53% nine-month 2026 profit growth
earnings_guidance.blurb: Net profit reached Rp135.4 billion through Q3, from Rp101.4 billion a year earlier, while sales rose 5.26% to Rp566.1 billion. Mirae Asset Sekuritas analyst Nafan Aji Gusta said PGUN’s 254x PER and 22.8x PBV put it above plantation peers and reflect a premium priced for very aggressive future profit growth.

earnings_guidance.event: Waskita Karya reports nine-month results amid ongoing restructuring
earnings_guidance.headline: WSKT reports Rp8.13 trillion nine-month revenue amid restructuring
earnings_guidance.blurb: Waskita Karya’s January-September 2026 revenue rose 53.73% year on year, while its Q3 net loss narrowed 9.54% to Rp2.87 trillion. Long-term bank loan payments rose 78.18% to Rp701.39 billion, and finance costs fell to Rp2.79 trillion. Since restructuring began in 2023, debt has declined 20.8% to Rp66.5 trillion.

deals_control.event: Bayan Resources addresses the Rp2,588-per-share transfer to Jhonlin
deals_control.headline: BYAN says it cannot explain Rp2,588-per-share transfers to Jhonlin
deals_control.blurb: Bayan said it was not a party to sales by Dato’ Low Tuck Kwong and Elaine Low to Jhonlin Baratama on 15 and 16 October under a Conditional Share Purchase Agreement. IDX asked Bayan to explain the price basis and the transactions’ link to the agreement, but Bayan did not confirm those details.
